title: Dimensionless Numbers
description: Physical and chemical dimensionless quantities - Reynolds number, Euler, Nusselt, and Prandtl number - and many more. Calculator for dimensionless numbers used in chemistry, fluid flow and physics engineering.

components.content:
# Dimensionless Numbers Calculator

Calculate various dimensionless quantities used in chemistry, fluid flow and physics engineering such as Reynolds number, Euler, Nusselt, and Prandtl number.

## Select a Dimensionless Number

Choose from the available dimensionless numbers below and enter the required parameters.

options.label: Euler number (Eu) - Energy losses in fluid flows
Froude number (Fr) - Resistance of submerged objects
Hartmann number (Ha) - Electromagnetic vs viscous force
Knudsen number (Kn) - Statistical vs continuum mechanics
Lewis number (Le) - Simultaneous heat and mass transfer
Nusselt number (Nu) - Convective vs conductive heat transfer
Peclet number (Pe) - Advective vs diffusive heat transport
Prandtl number (Pr) - Thermal conductivity of gases
Rayleigh number (Ra) - Conduction vs convection heat transfer
Schmidt number (Sc) - Momentum and mass diffusion
Stanton number (St) - Heat transfer in forced convection
Weber number (We) - Fluid flows with interface

## Symbol Definitions

| Symbol | Parameter | SI Unit |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| ν | Speed | m/s |
| η | Viscosity | kg/(m·s) |
| ρ | Density | kg/m³ |
| l | Length | m |
| a | Thermal diffusivity | m²/s |
| Δp | Pressure difference | kg/(m·s²) |
| g | Acceleration of free fall | m/s² |
| α | Cubic expansion coefficient | 1/K |
| ΔT | Temperature difference | K |
| λ | Mean free path | m |
| D | Diffusion coefficient | m²/s |
| c | Speed of sound | m/s |
| h | Heat transfer coefficient | kg/(s³·K) |
| k | Thermal conductivity | kg·m/(s³·K) |
| cp | Specific heat capacity | kg·m²/(s²·K) |
| f | Frequency | 1/s |
| γ | Surface tension | kg/s² |
| kd | Mass transfer coefficient | m/s |
